rules: Default ticket TTL is 72 hours; default want-ad TTL is 48 hours; default room TTL is 7 days.
Reject any envelope whose bound exceeds the default TTL for its kind.
Cap stored blobs: 64 KiB per ticket, 256 KiB per sealed drop.
There is no public listing of sealed-drop payloads.
refuse: Refuse envelopes with a TTL longer than the applicable default bound.
Refuse blobs over the size cap.
Refuse to list, index, or expose sealed-drop contents.
